Step-by-step guide to connecting your Stripe account
You\'ll need your own Stripe account and an Android 13+ phone with NFC. Card payments go to your Stripe account, not to your Cashu wallet.

In Stripe Dashboard, go to Developers → API keys → Create restricted key. Give it only \"Terminal Connection Tokens: Write\". Use an rk_live_ key for real payments or rk_test_ for testing. Never use a secret sk_ key.
In Stripe Dashboard, go to Terminal → Locations and create a location for your shop. Copy its tml_… ID. Use a separate restricted key for each phone so you can revoke it if the phone is lost.

Back in Numo, open Settings → Card payments. Paste the restricted key and Location ID, tap Test connection, then enable Accept card payments. Your key is encrypted on this phone and is never shown again.

At checkout, choose Card and follow the on-screen instructions. Ask the customer to tap their card or phone on your phone. Real cards require a release build; the simulated reader in Developer settings is only for testing with an rk_test_ key.
